build_seq2seq_model: build a Seq2Seq model with a custom encoder and decoder for sequence generation
build_tied_seq2seq_model: build a TiedSeq2Seq model that shares an LSTM unit between encoder and decoder
run_seq2seq_forward: run the Seq2Seq forward pass with source and target sequences and teacher forcing
init_seq2seq_weights: initialize Seq2Seq model weights with uniform distribution between -0.08 and 0.08
run_tied_seq2seq_forward: run the TiedSeq2Seq forward pass with shared LSTM encoder and decoder outputs
